resources.string: Select at least one app to block

🔒 Local VPN Technology

 This app uses Android's VPN API to block network access for selected apps. No data leaves your device.


📱 Important Limitations:

 • One VPN at a time: Android only allows one active VPN. If you use another VPN (corporate, privacy), this firewall will disconnect it.

 • Push notifications: Some apps may still receive push notifications through Google Play Services, as these bypass direct app connections.

 • System apps: Some system services cannot be blocked.


🛡️ Privacy:

 • No traffic inspection or logging
 • No data collection
 • No internet connection required for the firewall itself


⚡ How blocking works:

 Selected apps are routed through a local VPN tunnel that doesn't forward any packets, effectively cutting their internet access.
